budget.proposal_basis: previous 24-hour preference; this design does not start or allocate a run
budget.cost_currency: unknown without billing receipts; retain raw token usage
budget.start: before the first campaign research call, calibration or data processing; no free baseline/calibration allowance
budget.reserve: Reserve measured costs for attribution, final paired repetitions and frozen-suite assessment before admitting further search.

scheduling.calibration: Measure complete baseline units and memory/I/O contention; allocate parallelism from actual available resources.
scheduling.branching: Prospective mechanism branches and controls may be scheduled concurrently; preserve parent identities and avoid sharing live mutable code.
scheduling.default_initialization: from scratch; warm starts only as a declared controlled experimental condition

stop_conditions: no admissible useful experiment plus protected assessment fits
direction_policy: No fixed round quota or mandatory early abandonment. Continue, diagnose or switch according to evidence and expected information value within hard limits.
implementation_status: Design contract only. Data adapter, registry integration, causal feature builder and enforced execution boundary must be implemented and accepted before a real campaign.
